name: Setpoint
purpose: Adjust a target value (temperature) in steps, always showing the reported reading and normal range.

elements.label: What is being set.
elements.unit: Unit suffix; must not grow the value's line box.
elements.meta: Context line: reported reading and normal range, or pending / error message.

behavior: - / + change the desired value immediately; one command is committed 600 ms after the last tap.
Pending dims the value and shows a spinner; error reverts to the last applied value and says why.

a11y.notes: Step buttons carry localized aria-labels; meta is aria-live=polite.

lvgl.notes: Composite of two nn_button and labels.
